stemMd: Two objects are in thermal equilibrium with each other. Which property must they share?
explanationMd: Thermal equilibrium means no net heat transfer driven by a temperature difference. The objects therefore have equal temperature. They can still differ in mass, composition, volume and total internal energy.

distractorRationale.e: Equal temperature does not require equal mass.
distractorRationale.c: Internal energy also depends on amount and material.
distractorRationale.d: Different materials can be in thermal equilibrium.
